plumbing.responsibility: Shared/unclear until location of failure is confirmed
plumbing.guidance: Common-area or shared-stack plumbing is typically routed to HOA maintenance; fixtures inside a unit may be homeowner responsibility.
plumbing.approval_rule: Emergency escalation and vendor dispatch require manager approval.

electrical.responsibility: HOA for common-area fixtures; homeowner for most in-unit fixtures
electrical.guidance: Common hallway/garage lighting can be routed as HOA maintenance. Electrical hazards require escalation.

garage.guidance: Shared garage doors and access mechanisms are HOA-maintained common assets.
garage.approval_rule: Vendor dispatch or ticket creation requires approval.

elevator.guidance: Elevator outages are HOA responsibility; trapped occupants or safety issues require emergency escalation.

landscaping.guidance: Common landscaping issues can be routed to the HOA landscape vendor.

hvac.responsibility: Depends on whether equipment is unit-owned or common
hvac.approval_rule: Ambiguous responsibility should be reviewed by a manager.

other.guidance: Gather more information and escalate if responsibility or safety cannot be determined.
